description: Checks this connection and says what to fix and how: no singleplayer world open, WorldAPI unreachable or not installed, a wrong address, a missing, rejected, or too weak token, or read-only mode. Call it when a tool answers unreachable, no_world, invalid_token, token_required, or missing_scope, when a needed tool is missing, or when the user asks how to set this up.
